title: Offline RouteAct geometric-collision partner reconstruction

method.input: same raw-step behavior snapshot where events.geometric_collision=true
method.geometry: SAT over snapshot center x/y, physical heading radians, length, width
method.sat: same four axes and 0.05m leeway as envs/sumo/sumo_env.py::_oriented_boxes_overlap

sumo_coordinate_reference.source_conversion: front bumper to center via SUMO angle; physical heading is radians(90-angle)

interpretation_limits: The original telemetry stores geometric_collision as a boolean and does not store an explicit partner ID.
A unique overlap is reconstructed under the same geometric rule from the saved same-tick state; it is not an independent SUMO collision event or a liability/right-of-way judgment.
No SUMO raw collision participants/events were reported for these geometric-only rows.
